name: t287_count
sql: select ten287_bot.load_ticks('Superbet', '2026-09-12T00:00:00Z', '2026-09-29T06:02:00Z'); select count(*) n, count(*) filter (where side='home') home, min(at) min_at, max(at) max_at from pg_temp.t287

name: t287_ev
sql: select ten287_bot.load_ticks('Superbet', '2026-09-12T00:00:00Z', '2026-09-29T06:02:00Z'); select side, price, at, known_at from pg_temp.t287 where event_id = 15060042968 and at < '2026-09-27T07:20:00Z' order by side, at

name: raw_ev
sql: select t.id, t.back_home, t.back_away, t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at, t.event_status, t.src from ten287_rec.ticks t where t.book='Superbet' and t.event_id = 15060042968 and t.seen_at < '2026-09-27T07:20:00Z' order by t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at

name: raw_count
sql: select count(*) n from ten287_rec.ticks t join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) where t.book='Superbet' and e.tier is not null and coalesce(t.event_status, e.status) = 'pending' and t.book_updated_at is not null and t.book_updated_at between '2026-09-12T00:00:00Z' and '2026-09-29T06:02:00Z' and t.seen_at <= '2026-09-29T06:02:00Z'
